909	New Sage Pack, to acquire in the shop with Bubbles: Sage's Ring (all your bonus dice from the start of duels), pouch opening by 100, automatic recycling of duplicates (three copies kept at minimum), 1,000 Bubbles returned and ad-free play.
910	Favorites ♥: tap the heart on a collection die to protect it from recycling (manual and automatic); Favorites" filter in the collection.
Divine ceremony and Tèbre Glass Vial
Opening a Divine or Crackling die: new full-screen ceremony with pillar of light, runic halo, rainbow rays, shockwaves and golden title (tap to skip).

New equipped item: the Sacred Tèbre Glass Vial. If your deck contains only one element, all your rolls count one extra die. Reward for the "True to One's Element" challenge: win a duel on divine difficulty on each basic elemental terrain (water, fire, earth, wind, lightning, ice).
AI camera and Crackling dice in hand
During the AI's turn, the camera stays on its action until the end of the turn (move, die placement, roll), instead of leaving too early.
Hand cards also show the rarity of Crackling dice (e.g. "Crackling rare").
On the Collection and My Decks thumbnails, a Crackling die shows the rarity of its base die (e.g. "Crackling uncommon"), without opening the card.
Announcements have been grouped: one entry per major topic, without repetition.

Create your hero: name, permanent element, skin and eye color, animations and avatar. It awaits you in your zone to protect at the start of every game against the AI and levels up with you (level 5 maximum).
Hairstyles (short, long) and clothes of your choice, with the full palette: crew-neck or V-neck T-shirt, tank top, denim or fabric shorts, or a jumpsuit in 5 textures.
A new player follows a guided path: tutorial (optional), hero creation, shop with their 50 Bubbles, then the Play menu with the "Optimal deck" button highlighted.
In a camp's zone, only your own camp's tiles let you advance.
On phone, a long press on a creature opens its card; the camera follows the AI during its turn.
⏩ "Fast turns" button (also in Options › Game), Space to confirm on computer, "One more crossing!" banner when victory is near, and Sir Broom reacts at the end of the game.
Pouch dice have a metal frame in the color of their rarity, with engraved faces, character medallion and a discovery animation specific to each rarity.
Shop: on phone, the pouch fills almost the whole screen; buy 10 pouches and open them all at once, with a summary.
Duos and trios of multi-element dice are shown side by side in 3D.
The "Learn to play" button stays at hand: 4 small lessons, each a mini-game with a goal, on a neutral terrain.
The menu banner is cut out, the Announcements and Daily dice are aligned, and a little babyelemental sometimes peeks in.
Every base die exists in a Crackling version (52 dice): a Milky Way character, with galaxy texture, on the board as well as on the card and enlarged. It counts as its base die in deck limits.
The AI follows the same deck limits as you (1 divine, 2 legendary, 2 Energy dice, 4 rare at most).
The six babyelementals arrive, each with its die, along with new characters and multi-element dice: rare and legendary duos, divine trios.
On the ice terrain, babyelementals fight in place of the elementals.
Play 2 vs 2: against the AI with an AI ally, or online with tables open to all or private (code).
The PVP menu chooses the mode, Duel or 2 vs 2.
Guarantees: a missing legendary every 50 pouches without a legendary, a divine every 80 pouches (divines at 0.8%).
Each rarity has its number of tiles: 3, 4, 5, then 6 for legendary and divine; placing a rare die requires a 4 or more; legendaries roll two dice.
More compact die shapes, birth tile marked with a golden edge, and games checked over hundreds of simulations.
Rare dice with combat effects, card dice (Ice Wall, Ember Trap), class dice (healer, scout) and reserved dice.
New equipped items to earn through challenges: Golden Leaf, Miner's Lantern, Scarf, Bottomless Bag.
The White Spider and its great version, the Miner and its elemental variants, the Greater Hydrelithe, and many new 3D animated characters: crystals, stone statues, silver automatons and golden idols.
Divines are surrounded by a glowing aura, and legendary dice shine in your hand.
Autumn forest (Earth and Wind +1) and Christmas event terrain, the Night of Lights, from December 1 to January 6.
Neutral terrains: the city of Dassom and the underground cave. In Play mode, also choose the board shape (Narrow, Pillars, Hourglass, Two fords).
Sudden death: three 6s with three dice, four 6s with four dice (+10 Bubbles).
Higher-level die placed on an enemy creature: it disappears and its tile changes color.
A creature that has just appeared only moves on the next turn. Tap a creature again to deselect it.
Element cycle: Water › Fire › Ice › Earth › Wind › Lightning › Water, with a 3D wheel to the right of the board.
Mages cast a ball of their element, archers an elemental arrow, warriors strike with a luminous slash.
AP are shown in the element's color, without a frame, and the redesigned tiles are easier to read.
Six terrains, six 3D settings: Tender Wood, Scorched Lands, Road to Forfalla, Pink Lake, Sky Island and Winds of Hacko, with their fauna, flora and characters strolling around.
Sky Island: lightning strikes two tiles per turn. Winds of Hacko: a gust pushes creatures three tiles, and tornadoes carry a creature off with its tile. Pink Lake: a sacred lily gives +1 strength.
Synergies: certain linked characters gain +1 attack when together.
From level 5: propose your own die. Once approved, it joins the collection with your name, and you receive the Creator badge and 200 Bubbles.
Tavern Tales: a role-playing scene contest, with 300 Bubbles and the Screenwriter badge for the winner.
The game is getting ready to become an Android app, and launches without a connection once opened (Options › Save: "Download the whole game").
Automatic online saving, no account, and a recovery code to switch phones.
The Collection shows all dice, missing ones in silhouette, with their official number and tile shape. Recycle your duplicates into Bubbles.
Earn experience and level up: Bubbles at each level, three daily quests, a weekly quest and new bonus die effects to unlock.
3D characters and dice are 8 times lighter: faster loading, especially on phone.
Customize your bonus die effect in Options › Dice & pouch.
The Announcements die, Bubbles in the dice circle, victory by defeating 4 enemies, daily reward of 30 Bubbles (100 on the 7th day).
Energy rarity, equipped items, end-of-game animations, 8-column by 12-row board.
Story mode: the first chapters, with dialogues, illustrations and dice duels.
